purpose: dual-netspeed 第一次實跑的 B 段 (design.md 第7節: A 段成功才跑這段): both instances launch and log in, host creates a PvE room, joiner joins it and readies up -- then BOTH leave the room (single-client leave_room, focused explicitly per instance since it takes no client_id -- see actions.py) and close, same self-terminating rule as -a.json. Covers join_room/set_ready/idle_nudge (design.md L5's 80s room-idle kick mitigation) beyond what -a.json tested. Does NOT touch host_start_battle/enter_battle/console_cmd_on/leave_battle -- those are C段 only. Success = result PASS: join_room's ENTER_SA send pkt and set_ready's User_State_SN send pkt both show up (conn-filtered) in their step detail, both leave_room steps land on screen=lobby, both close_client steps report the process gone. If it halts, look first at join_room (ROOM_LIST_FIRST_ROW_CLICK is an UNTESTED coordinate per actions.py's own docstring -- a bad double-click there is the most likely first failure) and, if that passes, at set_ready/idle_nudge for an L5 80s-idle Leave_CQ appearing before set_ready's own pkt.
